nodes.label: Mita App
nodes.rationale: Micro-task checklist app with 3-5 tasks per day, streak tracking, local notifications, Flutter-based. Package: com.dreamstarx.mita. Neo-brutalist dark UI. AdMob integrated (disabled in v1.2+).

nodes.label: Neo-Brutalist Dark UI
nodes.rationale: Dark-themed neo-brutalist design system with high contrast, bold geometric shapes, flat/semi-flat design. Background #0D0D0D, accent #E94560, success #4CAF50.

nodes.label: Three-Task Daily Focus Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Limit daily tasks to 3 high-priority items to combat productivity anxiety. Tagline: 'Focus on what matters. Three tasks, one day.'

nodes.label: Local SQLite + SharedPreferences Data Architecture
nodes.rationale: All data stored locally on-device via SQLite (sqflite) for task storage and SharedPreferences for settings/streaks. No cloud sync, no external servers. WAL journal mode with synchronous FULL for durability.

nodes.label: AdMob Monetization
nodes.rationale: Google AdMob integration with Interstitial (Stats/History nav, max 3/session) and Rewarded (unlock history, streak shield, themes) ad units. Disabled in v1.2+ but kept in code.

nodes.label: Local Notification Scheduling System
nodes.rationale: flutter_local_notifications with daily reminders (7AM default), end-of-day check-in (10PM), task deadline reminders (1h before), weekly summary (Mon 9AM). inexactAllowWhileIdle for OEM battery restrictions.

nodes.label: Graphify Agent Knowledge Graph Tool
nodes.rationale: Agent skill for extracting knowledge graphs from codebases. Uses graphify-out/ directory, supports query/path/explain CLI commands, AST-only updates.

nodes.label: Design Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Color palette: #0D0D0D (Background), #1A1A1A (Surface), #E94560 (Accent coral), #4CAF50 (Success green), #888888 (Muted text), #FFFFFF (Text/Icon).

nodes.label: Space Grotesk & DM Sans Typography
nodes.rationale: Space Grotesk for Display/Stats/CTAs (bold geometric sans). DM Sans for Body/Tasks/UI Labels. Google Fonts.

nodes.label: Data Privacy & GDPR Compliance
nodes.rationale: No PII collected. Local-only storage. AdMob may collect device/ad identifiers with opt-out. Compliant with GDPR principles (minimization, purpose limitation), COPPA, Google Play policies.

nodes.label: Provider State Management Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses Provider (^6.1.2) for state management. TaskProvider as ChangeNotifier manages task state, stats, streak, and notification scheduling.

nodes.label: Flutter 3.2+ / Dart 3.2+ Framework
nodes.rationale: Built with Flutter 3.2+, Dart SDK >=3.2.0 <4.0.0. Target SDK 34, Min SDK 21 (Android 5.0).

nodes.label: Stats Calendar Day Detail Popup Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Popup showing day detail when tapping calendar day in stats screen. Implemented in stats_screen.dart.
nodes.norm_label: stats calendar day detail popup upgrade

nodes.label: Pomodoro Timer Focus Mode Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Configurable timer durations with session counter. Implemented in focus_screen.dart and pomodoro_provider.dart.

nodes.label: flutter_lints Lint Rules Package
nodes.rationale: Package:flutter_lints/flutter.yaml included for recommended Dart lints. Configured in analysis_options.yaml with customizable rules.

nodes.label: Google Play Console Release Guide
nodes.rationale: A release and submission reference outlining metadata, graphic assets, rating questionnaires, content disclosures, and build signing configurations for releasing Mita on the Google Play Store.

nodes.label: Mita Privacy Policy
nodes.rationale: Guarantees offline-first architecture by ensuring task data and analytics are stored strictly on-device in SQLite and SharedPreferences. Standardizes GDPR & COPPA compliance, detailing local data deletion options and AdMob third-party tracking controls.

nodes.label: Graphify Query Rules
nodes.rationale: Defines standard operational procedures for model agents when accessing the codebase graph, promoting scoped graph queries, wiki traversal, and AST updates.

nodes.label: Graphify Generation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Outlines instructions to execute the graphify skill and bootstrap navigable knowledge graphs within folders.

nodes.label: Objective-C Build Hook Executions
nodes.rationale: Tracks automated Flutter build hook runner command invocations targeting the objective_c packages inside the local pub cache.

nodes.label: Three Task Daily Limit
nodes.author: Leela Sai Vardhan
nodes.rationale: Limits active daily tasks to a maximum of 3 to combat productivity anxiety. Implementation forces UI-level constraints where the 'Add' action is dynamically disabled when the count is met.

nodes.label: Offline-First Local Storage Design
nodes.author: Leela Sai Vardhan
nodes.rationale: Maintains data ownership and maximum performance using local SQLite (sqflite) tables for tasks and SharedPreferences/Android broadcasts for native home screen widget updates.

nodes.label: AdMob Monetization Strategy
nodes.rationale: Displays non-intrusive interstitial ads during screen transitions (capped at 3/session) and optional user-triggered rewarded videos to avoid hindering primary task management flows.

nodes.label: Objective-C Flutter Packages
nodes.rationale: Implicit Objective-C support package used for native interactions on iOS. Invocations of local hooks runner reflect Dart's native assets / FFI compilation steps.
